players.name: Lionel Messi
players.signatureMoment: Leading Argentina to World Cup glory in Qatar 2022, scoring 7 goals and winning the Golden Ball.
players.bio: Widely regarded as the greatest player in football history. An 8-time Ballon d'Or winner possessing unparalleled low-gravity balance, alien dribbling, supernatural passing range, and devastating free-kick precision.

timeline.honors: 10 La Liga, 4 UCL, 7 Copa del Rey, 6 Ballon d'Or at club

players.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
players.signatureMoment: Overhead bicycle kick against Juventus in Turin (2018 UCL) and leading Real Madrid to a historic Champions League three-peat.
players.bio: Football's all-time record goalscorer. An athletic phenomenon who conquered England, Spain, Italy, and international football through relentless drive, clutch aerial supremacy, and deadly finishing with both feet.

timeline.honors: 4 UCL, 2 La Liga, 4 Ballon d'Or, All-Time Real Madrid top scorer
2 Serie A, 1 Coppa Italia, Serie A Footballer of the Year
Sir Matt Busby Player of the Year

players.name: Pelé
players.signatureMoment: Scoring twice in the 1958 World Cup Final as a 17-year-old and lifting 3 World Cups (1958, 1962, 1970).
players.bio: 'O Rei' (The King). The only player in history to win three FIFA World Cups. A pioneer who defined modern football artistry, athleticism, and global cultural stardom.

timeline.honors: 2 Copa Libertadores, 2 Intercontinental Cups, 6 Série A

players.name: Diego Maradona
players.eraLabel: El Pibe de Oro / Hall of Fame
players.signatureMoment: The 1986 'Goal of the Century' vs England, dribbling past five defenders from inside his own half.
players.bio: A footballing deity whose passion, left-footed sorcery, and defiance carried Argentina to World Cup victory in 1986 and brought southern Italy its first Scudetti with Napoli.

timeline.honors: Copa del Rey, Copa de la Liga
2 Serie A (1987, 1990), 1 UEFA Cup, 1 Coppa Italia
Legendary return to European and Argentine football

players.name: Zinedine Zidane
players.signatureMoment: The iconic left-foot volley in the 2002 Champions League final at Hampden Park and two headed goals in the 1998 World Cup final.
players.bio: The definition of elegance and poise. Zidane controlled the biggest games in football history like a grandmaster, fusing breathtaking Roulette turns with majestic first touches.

timeline.honors: UEFA Intertoto Cup, UEFA Cup Final
2 Serie A, UEFA Super Cup, 1998 Ballon d'Or

players.name: Ronaldo (R9)
players.signatureMoment: Scoring both goals in the 2002 World Cup Final against Oliver Kahn to seal Brazil's 5th World Cup star.
players.bio: 'Il Fenomeno'. At his peak, R9 was an unstoppable force of nature, combining frightening acceleration, elastico stepovers, and cold composure around goalkeepers.

timeline.honors: Copa del Rey, UEFA Cup Winners' Cup, 1997 Ballon d'Or
UEFA Cup 1998, Serie A Player of the Year
2002 Ballon d'Or, 2 La Liga, Intercontinental Cup

players.name: Ronaldinho
players.signatureMoment: Receiving a standing ovation from Real Madrid fans at the Santiago Bernabéu after scoring two solo wonder goals in 2005.
players.bio: The player who made the entire planet smile. An entertainer whose no-look passes, flip-flaps, overhead kicks, and effortless joy reinvigorated FC Barcelona and world football.

players.name: Johan Cruyff
players.signatureMoment: Inventing the iconic 'Cruyff Turn' against Sweden in the 1974 World Cup and orchestrating Ajax's European Cup three-peat.
players.bio: The founding father of Total Football. Cruyff revolutionized tactical philosophy as both player and manager, winning three consecutive European Cups with Ajax and reshaping Barcelona's DNA.

timeline.honors: 1974 La Liga Title, Copa del Rey
Dutch League & Cup Double in final season

players.name: Paolo Maldini
players.signatureMoment: Lifting the UEFA Champions League trophy as Milan captain in 2003 and 2007 across 25 extraordinary seasons.
players.bio: The standard for defensive mastery. Maldini spent his entire 25-season professional career with AC Milan, perfecting slide tackling, positional intelligence, and graceful leadership without committing fouls.

timeline.honors: 5 UEFA Champions League titles, 7 Serie A titles, 5 UEFA Super Cups

players.name: Andrés Iniesta
players.signatureMoment: Scoring the 116th-minute World Cup winning goal for Spain against Netherlands in Johannesburg (2010).
players.bio: The poet of Tiki-Taka. Iniesta glided past midfields with ghost-like spatial awareness, deciding the 2010 World Cup Final, 2012 Euros, and 2009 Stamford Bridge semifinal.

timeline.honors: 4 UCL, 9 La Liga, 6 Copa del Rey, UEFA Best Player in Europe 2012

players.name: Thierry Henry
players.signatureMoment: Leading Arsenal's historic 49-game unbeaten 'Invincibles' season (2003/04), finishing as top scorer and player of the season.
players.bio: Arsenal's record goalscorer and the Premier League's most lethal artist. Famed for his signature curling finish into the far right corner from the left wing.

timeline.honors: 2 Premier League (Invincibles 03/04), 4 Golden Boots, All-Time Club Top Scorer
2009 Sextuple Winner (UCL, La Liga, Copa del Rey)

players.name: Gianluigi Buffon
players.signatureMoment: Conceding only 2 goals (an own goal and a penalty) during Italy's triumphant 2006 World Cup campaign in Germany.
players.bio: The gold standard of goalkeeping. Spanning nearly 30 years and over 1,150 matches, Buffon kept over 500 clean sheets and claimed 10 Serie A titles.

timeline.honors: 10 Serie A Titles, 5 Coppa Italia, 3 UCL Finals
Heroic farewell where his career started

players.name: Kylian Mbappé
players.signatureMoment: Scoring a breathtaking hat-trick in the 2022 World Cup Final against Argentina to win the Golden Boot at age 23.
players.bio: The blistering heir to football's throne. A World Cup champion at 19 whose electrifying acceleration, direct dribbling, and cold finishing make him European football's ultimate weapon.

timeline.honors: 6 Ligue 1 Titles, All-Time PSG Top Scorer

players.name: Erling Haaland
players.signatureMoment: Breaking the all-time Premier League single-season scoring record with 36 goals in his debut 2022/23 treble-winning campaign.
players.bio: A physical and psychological monster inside the 18-yard box. Boasting a goal-per-game strike rate across the Champions League and Premier League, Haaland is modern football's definitive apex predator.

timeline.honors: Austrian Bundesliga, Historic UCL Hat-Trick Debut
DFB-Pokal Winner 2021, Bundesliga Player of Season
Continental Treble 2023, 2 Premier League, 2 Golden Boots

players.name: Lamine Yamal
players.signatureMoment: Curling an unforgettable 25-yard equalizer against France in the Euro 2024 semi-final at age 16.
players.bio: The youngest superstar in modern football history. Breaking every record set by Pelé and Messi for teenage brilliance, Yamal won UEFA Euro 2024 as the tournament's best young player.

timeline.honors: UEFA Euro 2024 Winner & Young Player of Tournament

players.name: Vinicius Jr
players.fullName: Vinícius José Paixão de Oliveira Júnior
players.signatureMoment: Scoring in two separate UEFA Champions League finals (2022 vs Liverpool & 2024 vs Dortmund) to lead Madrid to European crowns.
players.bio: Real Madrid's electrifying talisman. From arriving as an 18-year-old talent from Flamengo to being named Champions League Player of the Season, Vinicius defines modern big-game dominance.

timeline.honors: 2 Champions League (2022, 2024), 3 La Liga, 2024 UCL Player of Season

players.name: Jude Bellingham
players.signatureMoment: Scoring 95th-minute stoppage-time winners in both La Liga El Clásicos during his historic debut Real Madrid campaign.
players.bio: The all-action box-to-box maestro. Wearing Zidane's number 5 at the Santiago Bernabéu, Bellingham captured the Golden Boy, La Liga Player of the Season, and the Champions League trophy.

timeline.honors: Champions League 2024, La Liga 2024, Golden Boy 2023

players.name: Mohamed Salah
players.signatureMoment: Scoring 32 goals in a single 38-game Premier League season and firing Liverpool to their first Premier League title in 30 years.
players.bio: Anfield's record-breaking Egyptian King. Combining mesmerizing speed, creative assists, and consistency, Salah is one of the greatest wingers in Premier League history.

timeline.honors: 1 UCL (2019), 1 Premier League (2020), 3 Golden Boots, Club Top Scorer in Europe

players.name: Harry Kane
players.signatureMoment: Becoming England's all-time record goalscorer and winning the 2024 European Golden Shoe with 36 Bundesliga strikes.
players.bio: England's captain and supreme modern number 9. Fusing predatory box movement with world-class playmaker vision and precision long-range passing.

timeline.honors: All-Time Spurs Top Scorer, 3 Premier League Golden Boots

players.name: Kevin De Bruyne
players.signatureMoment: Setting the record for 20 assists in a single Premier League campaign and guiding City to their historic 2023 Treble.
players.bio: The premier midfield passer of his generation. Bending physics with trademark low diagonal crosses through packed defenses, De Bruyne is a two-time Premier League Player of the Season.

timeline.honors: 1 UCL (2023), 6 Premier League, 2 PFA Players' Player of Year

players.name: Rodri
players.signatureMoment: Scoring the winning goal in the 2023 Champions League Final in Istanbul and winning the 2024 Ballon d'Or.
players.bio: The 2024 Ballon d'Or recipient and the beating heart of Manchester City and Spain. Unbeaten in over 70 consecutive club matches, Rodri anchors defenses with unmatched tactical intelligence.

timeline.honors: 2024 Ballon d'Or, 1 UCL (2023), 4 Premier League Titles

players.name: Luka Modrić
players.signatureMoment: Breaking the Messi-Ronaldo Ballon d'Or monopoly in 2018 after leading Croatia to the World Cup Final and winning his 3rd straight UCL.
players.bio: The ageless maestro. Six-time UEFA Champions League champion, 2018 Ballon d'Or winner, and captain of Croatia's golden generation. Revered for his trademark outside-of-the-boot 'trivela' passes.

timeline.honors: 6 UEFA Champions League titles (Joint Record), 4 La Liga, 2018 Ballon d'Or
2018 World Cup Golden Ball, World Cup Final & 3rd Place

players.name: Robert Lewandowski
players.signatureMoment: Scoring 5 goals in 9 minutes as a substitute against Wolfsburg in 2015, breaking the Guinness World Record.
players.bio: The most ruthless penalty-box finisher of the 2010s and 2020s. Breaking Gerd Müller's historic 40-goal single-season Bundesliga record with 41 goals in 2021.

timeline.honors: 2020 Sextuple, 8 Bundesliga, 2x FIFA The Best Men's Player

players.name: Virgil van Dijk
players.signatureMoment: Going 65 consecutive competitive games without any player successfully dribbling past him (2018-2019).
players.bio: UEFA Men's Player of the Year in 2019 and Ballon d'Or runner-up. The defensive linchpin who transformed Liverpool into European and Premier League champions.

timeline.honors: Champions League (2019), Premier League (2020), UEFA Player of the Year

players.name: Zlatan Ibrahimović
players.signatureMoment: The 35-yard overhead bicycle kick against England in 2012 that won the FIFA Puskás Award.
players.bio: A larger-than-life martial-arts footballer. Scoring over 570 goals across four different decades, Zlatan won league titles in the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and France.

timeline.honors: La Liga, UEFA Super Cup, Club World Cup
4 Ligue 1, 1 Serie A, 3x Ligue 1 Top Scorer

players.name: Kaká
players.eraLabel: Il Bambino d'Oro / Hall of Fame
players.signatureMoment: His solo sprint and headed goal between Heinze and Evra at Old Trafford in the 2007 UCL semifinal, on the way to winning the 2007 Ballon d'Or.
players.bio: The last human to win the Ballon d'Or before the Messi-Ronaldo era began. A graceful long-striding playmaker whose bursts through the center of the pitch were unstoppable.

timeline.honors: 2007 Ballon d'Or, 2007 UCL, Serie A Title 2004

players.name: Xavi Hernández
players.eraLabel: Master of Tiki-Taka / Hall of Fame
players.signatureMoment: Providing 4 assists in Barcelona's famous 6-2 El Clásico victory at the Santiago Bernabéu and orchestrating Spain's 2010 World Cup victory.
players.bio: The brain of the greatest club and national teams ever assembled. Xavi operated with a 360-degree radar in his mind, rarely losing possession in over a thousand matches.

timeline.honors: 2010 World Cup, Euro 2008 & 2012 Player of Tournament
